QuestInfo.name: [Phantom Forest] Taggrin's Purpose
QuestInfo.0: Taggrin, the leader of the Raven Ninja, is more than a little familiar with the ancient history of Masteria. Listen to what he has to say.
QuestInfo.1: Taggrin says he learned much of what he knows about Masteria's history from Lireni's Log, the record book of their predecessor, Grandmaster Lireni. Admitting he lent Lireni's Log to the Masteria Research Team, he asks you to search for them. You have a feeling you'll find clues in one of the caverns beneath Crimsonwood Mountain, which rises in the distance beyond the Phantom Forest.
QuestInfo.2: You met Becky, the youngest member of the Masteria Research Team, in one of Crimsonwood Mountain's caverns!
QuestInfo.summary: Find the Masteria researcher in one of the caverns beneath Crimsonwood Mountain.

npc.0: You were told that the research team is conducting their investigation somewhere near Crimsonwood Mountain, so you should be able to find them if you wander around the area.
